DATE RECEIVED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

TEST PERFORMED
Karyotype Analysis - G-banded Chromosome Study

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured, harvested, and G-banded according to standard cytogenetic protocols. Metaphase chromosomes were analyzed at the 400-550 band level resolution.

RESULT
46,XX

Normal female karyotype

INTERPRETATION
G-banded chromosome analysis reveals a normal female karyotype with no evidence of trisomy 21 or other significant chromosomal abnormalities. Twenty metaphase cells were analyzed. The analysis quality was sufficient to exclude numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements.

This study supersedes the previous rapid FISH analysis performed on [redacted date].

CLINICAL CORRELATION
No chromosomal abnormalities consistent with Down syndrome or other major chromosomal disorders were detected.

LIMITATIONS
This analysis can detect numerical abnormalities and structural rearrangements larger than approximately 5-10 Mb. Smaller deletions, duplications, or balanced rearrangements may not be detected by this methodology.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD
